name: Frequency
tooltip: Centre of the band the esses sit in

name: Width
tooltip: How wide the listened band is; wider also catches air

name: Threshold
tooltip: Where reduction starts; relative to the voice when Relative is on
notes: Unit reads dB rel when relative=1

name: Range
tooltip: The most it ever takes away, so no ess vanishes

name: Mode
tooltip: Wide ducks all, Split the band, Spectral only the hissing bins

name: Auto
tooltip: Finds the band on the first play, then leaves the knobs to you

name: Relative
tooltip: Follows how sibilant a moment is, not how loud

name: Speed
tooltip: Fast grabs the onset, Smooth rides through long esses

name: Lookahead
tooltip: Sees the ess before it arrives; adds that much latency
notes: Changes reported latency; disabled in Spectral

name: Listen
tooltip: Ess plays what it hears, Delta only what it removes

name: Stereo
tooltip: Link both channels, Mid only the centre, Dual each on its own

name: Mix
tooltip: Blends the untreated voice back in
